description: Source code implementing a hardware-based pseudo-random number generator function 'raw_truerand' with platform-specific timing and interrupt handling, including comments on usage and limitations.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Sets a timer interval for generating timing-based entropy.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Handles timer signal, updates 'done' flag or performs a long jump based on platform.

methods.name: roulette
methods.description: Collects entropy by timing loop counts and signal handling, returns a pseudo-random number.

methods.name: raw_truerand
methods.description: Generates a 32-bit pseudo-random number by calling 'roulette' multiple times.
